question:
**Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Appropriate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Competent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**appropriate**" means suitable, fitting, or proper for a given context or situation. (किसी दिए गए संदर्भ या स्थिति के लिए उपयुक्त, उपयुक्त या उचित)

 
 
• **Example**: *She made an appropriate choice for the team leader position.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Competent **means suitable or qualified for a particular task or purpose. (किसी विशेष कार्य या उद्देश्य के लिए उपयुक्त या योग्य)
 
• It can also mean having the necessary skills or knowledge to do something successfully.
 
 
• **Example**: *She was the most competent candidate for the job and was hired immediately.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, "competent" can be a synonym for "appropriate" when used in the context of being fit or suitable for a specific purpose or situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Polarize **means to divide or cause to divide into two sharply contrasting groups or sets of opinions or beliefs. (दो बिल्कुल विपरीत समूहों या मतों या विश्वासों के समूह में विभाजित करना या विभाजित करना)
 
• **Informal **means relaxed, friendly, or unofficial. (आरामदेह, मैत्रीपूर्ण, या अनौपचारिक)
 
• **Gentle** means mild, kind, or soft in nature or character. (सौम्य, दयालु, या स्वभाव या चरित्र में नरम)
